i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load issue #142, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, and the latent_power loss/network/config code. Record pass when loaded.

q2.title: Config surface: always-on vs tunable lambda
q2.imperative: Since old behavior is not preserved, is the sigma NLL always-on (no opt-in), or a tunable lambda that simply defaults to a nonzero weight? And does the existing lambda_sigma_nll knob stay or get removed?
q2.finding: ANSWERED (b): keep tunable lambda_sigma_nll knob, default to a nonzero weight; drop the gold-cycle !=0.0 rejection. Sigma trained on the default path; still ablatable.

q3.title: Target space in bce mode (logit vs probability residual)
q3.imperative: mu is a logit; outcome is in {0,1}. Issue proposes (mu.detach() - outcome)^2 which mixes logit and probability scales. Use probability residual (sigmoid(mu).detach() - outcome) instead for a dimensionally coherent Gaussian NLL target?
q3.finding: ANSWERED: reject bce probability/logit residual. The bce logit path is a BACKUP that violates one-canonical-path. Canonical = retro_delta (retro power predictor); sigma calibration target lives in retro power-delta units (target_mu), divorced from probability, so residual (mu - target_mu) is dimensionally coherent.

q4.title: Detach the mean head
q4.imperative: Detach mu in the sigma NLL so sigma calibration does not perturb the mean head gradient (issue proposes detach)?
q4.finding: ANSWERED yes: B detaches mu (core of two-task design; isolates sigma calibration from mean-head gradient).

q5.title: Interaction with retro_delta mode
q5.imperative: retro_delta already calibrates sigma via student_t_nll. Is the new sigma NLL bce-only (retro_delta unchanged), or applied in both modes?
q5.finding: RESOLVED: bce retired. B is bce-N/A; applies in the sole retro_delta path alongside A.

q6.title: Sigma-collapse safeguard
q6.imperative: Rely on existing sigma_floor + triangle_loss upward pressure to balance the NLL log(sigma^2) term, or add an explicit clamp/variance prior?
q6.finding: DECIDED: add a solve-side W-cap (new knob, e.g. solve_sigma_floor on LatentPowerConfig) applied in field_solve before W=1/sigma^2; keep training sigma_floor=1e-3 untouched. Rationale: protects GLS conditioning against sigma collapse on confident pairs (esp. race-start small residuals) WITHOUT compressing the trained sigma dynamic range that feeds the uncertainty signal. Heavy-tail saturation guards the upper side; this guards the lower. Default conservative (effective sigma_min ~0.05 -> W_max ~400), confirm empirically from smoke run sigma distribution. Lands in sigma-calibration gate, not Gate 1.

q7.title: Gold-cycle passthrough scope
q7.imperative: Now canonical: do we remove the gold_cycle config non-zero rejection and wire passthrough (run.py + _module_train_args) in THIS issue, and what evidence validates it? Or is gold-cycle a separate follow-up?
q7.finding: DECIDED: full end-to-end IN THIS ISSUE. Tier A (config knob + term B + run.py/CLI wiring) + Tier B (remove gold !=0.0 rejection, wire _module_train_args, gold config tests) + Tier C-FULL (full gold retrain, Brier-primary comparison vs current promoted baseline, sigma_pi dynamic range + corr checks, promote params/gold artifacts). Full retrain is the LAST gate. enable_sigma_calibration (post-hoc) and lambda_sigma_nll (training-time) are orthogonal; only training-time path wired.

q8.title: Default weight value (if lambda retained)
q8.imperative: If a weight remains, what default? Note: with sigma ~10-17, log(sigma^2) ~5-6 dominates and pushes sigma down hard relative to BCE ~0.69 scale; weight choice is material. SPECULATIVE recommendation needs flagging.
q8.finding: DECIDED: lambda_sigma_nll default = 1.0 (co-equal sigma-calibration task; detached so it cannot destabilize mean head). Anchor value; gold sweep tunes. A and B are same Student-t form, mean-reduced => total sigma-gradient ~ (1+lambda)*g_studentt_scale.

q9.title: Acceptance evidence: must sigma demonstrably vary?
q9.imperative: Is acceptance just unit-tested loss math, or must we also demonstrate sigma responds to confidence (a smoke/diagnostic)? Full gold backtest/Brier comparison in scope or future?
q9.finding: RESOLVED via gate structure: (G1) latent_power unit suite green post triangle/bce removal, symmetry kept, no bce refs; (G2) unit tests for term B detached student-t + lambda weighting + LossBundle.sigma_nll field + field_solve W-cap test + config validation; (G3) run.py CLI arg + gold rejection removed + gold config tests; (G4) research/smoke run: sigma dynamic range materializes, field_solve conditioning holds; (G5) full gold retrain: Brier-primary vs current promoted baseline (no regression / improvement), sigma_pi dynamic range + corr(sigma_pi,accuracy) checks, promote params/gold artifacts.

q10.title: Architecture baseline needed
q10.imperative: Do we need a cartographer packet read for latent_power before planning, or is the loss/network/config read sufficient?
q10.finding: RESOLVED: existing packet docs/architecture/packets/latent_power.md + code reads are a sufficient pre-plan baseline; no cartographer subagent needed pre-plan. Packet is STALE (presents bce/triangle as canonical, target_mode two-valued) -> reconcile gate must update. ADR touchpoints: ADR 0001 (latent_power must not import evo -- our split honors it) and ADR 0008 (Student-t nu=4 fixed; retiring bce makes target_mode single-valued -> ADR 0008 note/update needed).

q11.title: Committed-artifact / manifest compatibility
q11.imperative: Does changing the training loss invalidate committed gold artifacts/manifests or schema expectations? Retrain in scope or tracked follow-up?
q11.finding: RESOLVED by Q7: gold retrain regenerates+promotes params/gold bundles + sampled_runtime_manifest, superseding committed artifacts. gold_report_schema already carries lambda_sigma_nll/pairwise_sigma_nll_enabled fields; confirm schema version/consumers during final gate.

q3a.title: Redundancy with existing student_t sigma training
q3a.imperative: retro_delta already trains sigma jointly via student_t_nll. What is this issue's actual delta given that?
q3a.finding: LOCKED direction (i)+retire bce: canonical=retro_delta. A=Student-t NLL trains mu (unchanged). B=detached Student-t NLL (mu.detach(), shared nu) trains sigma, weighted lambda_sigma_nll. Same per-pair optimum sigma=|r|, B is a (1+lambda)x amplifier on the saturating sigma gradient; mu untouched. Heavy-tail robustness preserved.

q-tri.title: Triangle/symmetry disposition
q-tri.imperative: Retire triangle_loss entirely; KEEP symmetry_loss (network output antisymmetry NOT guaranteed - corrected). Triangle+dead-bce removal = Gate 1 entry/cleanup gate, lands first.
q-tri.finding: DECIDED: remove triangle_loss; keep symmetry_loss; remove dead bce code/path (retro_delta becomes sole canonical path). This is Gate 1 (small entry gate before the sigma improvement). Recoverable via git if regretted.

consolidation.summary: Issue 142 resolved understanding: Make retro_delta the SOLE canonical training path and give the sigma head a real, isolated training signal. (1) Gate1 cleanup: remove triangle_loss + all dead bce code/path; KEEP symmetry_loss (network antisymmetry not guaranteed). (2) Add term B = detached Student-t NLL (mu.detach(), shared nu=4) weighted lambda_sigma_nll (default 1.0) so sigma trains to |residual| with heavy-tail robustness preserved; A (Student-t) still trains mu. (3) Add solve-side W-cap knob in field_solve to guard GLS conditioning vs sigma collapse on confident pairs (esp race-start), training sigma_floor untouched. (4) Wire end-to-end: LatentPowerConfig knob, run.py CLI, remove gold !=0.0 rejection, gold config tests. (5) Smoke validation then FULL gold retrain w/ Brier-primary baseline comparison + sigma_pi dynamic-range/corr checks + promote params/gold artifacts as final gate. Docs: update latent_power packet + ADR 0008.
